# Simple Alerts

Open-source, self-hosted Next.js error alerts delivered to Telegram.

- Source and installation: https://github.com/gibtang/simple-alerts
- SDK integration: https://github.com/gibtang/simple-alerts/tree/main/packages/nextjs
- /login: Operator login.
- /: Authenticated project overview and deliveries.
- /groups/{id}: Authenticated error group and occurrence details.
- /privacy: Data handling and retention.
- /terms: Self-hosted software terms.
- /api/health: Database and worker readiness.

No anonymous access to error reports. Never submit secrets to an installation without its operator's authorization.
